title: nav-pilot profile
description: Centrally published defaults that a released nav-pilot picks up without being rebuilt. Advisory only: nav-pilot falls back to its compiled-in defaults whenever the profile is missing, unreachable, or fails this schema.

profileVersion.description: Profile contract version. A binary that does not know the version declared here ignores the whole profile and keeps its compiled-in defaults.

note.description: Free text for whoever opens the file. Ignored by nav-pilot.

defaultModels.description: Client id to model id, used only when the user has pinned no model of their own. A client absent here keeps nav-pilot's compiled-in default.
